After eight years of trading cryptocurrencies, I have grown an initial capital of 50,000 to over 50 million, relying on the core principle of "holding a 50% position steadily," maintaining a monthly return of 70%. I passed this method on to my apprentice, and he doubled his funds in three months. Today, I am sharing my hard-earned experiences with you, which are lessons learned from real money; be sure to remember them!

1. Capital Management
Funds are divided into 5 parts, with a single stock at 1/5 position; stop loss at 10 points (a single mistake results in a 2% total capital loss), take profit ≥ 10 points.
2. Follow the Trend
Rebounds during a decline often lure buyers, while corrections during an uptrend present opportunities; buying low is steadier than bottom fishing.
3. Avoiding Pitfalls
Do not engage with cryptocurrencies that surge in the short term; those that stagnate at high levels will inevitably drop, do not be greedy for tail-end profits.
4. MACD Signal
Golden cross below the zero line and breakout = enter; death cross above the zero line pointing down = reduce position.
5. Iron Rule for Supplementing Positions
Do not average down on losses; only add to positions when profitable, avoid adding more on increasing losses.
6. Key to Volume and Price
Pay attention to breakout with volume at low levels; decisively exit when volume increases but price stagnates at high levels.
7. Trend Selection for Cryptocurrencies
3-day moving average trending up = short-term; 30-day moving average = medium-term; 84-day moving average = main upward trend; 120-day moving average = long-term.
8. Daily Review
Check the logic of holding positions, observe the weekly candlestick trends, and adjust strategies when the trend changes.

title: Вчера на уровне $3000 за ETH была замечена высокая активность его покупки. Не так все однозначно!
subTitle:
Когда на конкретном уровне цены вдруг появляется плотный поток покупок, рынок подает важный сигнал: по этой цене кто то готов забирать значительный объем риска на себя. История с активным выкупом $ETH  в районе 3000 выглядит именно так. Да, график мог какое то время смотреться угрожающе, новости подогревали страх, а часть участников уже мысленно рисовала себе намного более низкие уровни. Но когда под свечами проявляется крупный спрос, это ломает простую картинку “все падает, надо спасаться”. Для крупных игроков 3000 в такой ситуации становится не просто цифрой на экране, а зоной, где они считают асимметрию по риску и доходности достаточно привлекательной.
{future}(ETHUSDT)

Важно понимать, что такая покупка не отменяет тренд автоматически, но меняет баланс сил. До появления массивного спроса сценарий “усиливающегося падения” выглядел для многих базовым: негативный фон, техническая слабость, вынос плечевых позиций. Высокая активность на покупку в момент теста уровня показывает, что на другом конце провода сидят не только напуганные продавцы, но и те, кто воспринимает текущую просадку как возможность войти или нарастить позицию. Это не гарантированный разворот, но явный индикатор того, что под поверхностью идет борьба, а не капитуляция.
Еще один момент, о котором редко думают в момент паники: крупные покупки часто совмещают сразу несколько задач. Кто то хеджирует долгосрочные обязательства по эфиру, кто то закрывает шорты и разворачивается вверх, кто то строит сложные опционные конструкции. Суммарный объем в сотни миллионов не всегда означает “кто то один зашел по рынку”, но в любом случае отражает концентрацию интереса на выбранной цене. Для среды, где активно работают алгоритмы, фонды и маркетмейкеры, такие кластеры ликвидности превращаются в ориентиры: уровень, где недавно прошел крупный выкуп, дальше будет внимательно отслеживаться всеми участниками.
На горизонте ближайшего месяца это добавляет рынку неоднозначности, и в хорошем смысле. С одной стороны, риск продолжения падения никуда не исчез: макрофон, регуляторные сюрпризы или новый виток распродаж со стороны крупных держателей легко могут снова продавить ETH ниже. С другой — появление крупного покупателя на 3000 делает простой сценарий “обвала без сопротивления” менее вероятным. Если цена вернется к этому уровню, все будут смотреть, повторится ли выкуп, насколько быстро объем предложения будет переварен, и как ведут себя деривативы.
Лично я воспринимаю этот эпизод как напоминание: однонаправленные ожидания на рынке криптовалют почти всегда опасны. В те моменты, когда лента новостей и соцсети кричат о неминуемом крахе, где то в стакане могут аккуратно собирать позицию те, кто смотрит на горизонт в кварталы и годы, а не в часы. Крупный выкуп на уровне 3000 не делает рост #ETH  и всего рынка гарантированным сценарием на месяц вперед, но ясно показывает, что для части капитала текущие цены не выглядят “однозначно завышенными”. А значит, вместо простого нарратива “все падает” у нас появляется более честная картина: рынок балансирует между страхом и интересом к риску, и именно в такой фазе формируются самые интересные точки входа — как для быков, так и для медведей, которые умеют вовремя признавать, что картинка изменилась.

title: 梗王归来！DOGE历史形态重现，牛市信号炸裂！
subTitle:
今年币圈太热闹，#BTC 、#sol 、#ETH  集体刷存在感，但最近一位老牌“梗王”又悄悄站上舞台——狗狗币（#DOGE ）。而且不只是情绪带动，有技术分析师发现，狗狗币的长期图表正在复制上一个大周期的走势，关键支撑位已经到位，如果历史再次重演，DOGE 可能真的要冲击 1 美元。
下面我们来顺一下这波逻辑。
关键支撑位再现，走势和上轮牛市几乎一样
目前狗狗币正踩在一个非常关键的长期支撑位上，这个位置在上一轮上涨周期（2023~2024）也曾出现，并成为了 DOGE 大幅飙升的起点。
加密货币分析师 Trader Tardigrade 最近在 X（原推特）上表示，DOGE 当前的周线行情与上一轮大涨前几乎完全一致。他指出，狗狗币在 2021-2026、大周期范围内，已经第三次触碰长期支撑趋势线。

在上次周期中，DOGE在支撑区连续三次收线后，就开始了缓慢但稳定的上涨，并一路走到周期高点。如今的走势结构和当时高度重合，K线持续沿上升趋势线震荡，并形成更高低点，意味着筹码正在向上集中。
换句话说，如果走“前车之路”，狗狗币确实具备再走一波中期牛市的可能性。
分析师大胆预测：这波有机会冲 1 美元甚至突破
那到底能涨多高？
Trader Tardigrade 给出一个十分大胆的目标：如果市场形态继续复制上轮走势，DOGE 可能从当前约 0.15 美元一路冲到 1.10 美元。

在他的图表中，有一个明显的大矩形区域——代表预计的 2024~2025 上升周期。他认为价格结构仍有扩张空间，如果市场延续历史规律，那么本轮上涨可能在 2026 年前后达到新的峰值。

长周期看，多头的格局并没有坏，甚至可能刚刚开始。

BlackRock Registers iShares Staked Ethereum Trust in Delaware, Signaling Next Phase for ETH ETFs

BlackRock has taken a major step toward a staking-enabled Ethereum ETF by registering the iShares Staked Ethereum Trust in Delaware. The move mirrors the early filings the firm made before launching its Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, suggesting a formal SEC submission could follow soon.

🔑 Key Highlights:

✅ BlackRock registers the iShares Staked Ethereum Trust

✅ Trust would allow ETH to be staked, with rewards paid to investors

✅ SEC recently acknowledged Nasdaq’s request to add staking to BlackRock’s ETH ETF

✅ ETHA remains the largest ETH ETF with $11.5B AUM

The registration signals growing momentum for staking-based ETFs, which would let fund managers earn staking rewards on behalf of clients. Bloomberg’s Eric Balchunas noted that this type of Delaware trust often appears shortly before a full SEC filing.

The development comes as the SEC removed the 19b-4 filing requirement for certain crypto ETPs that meet new listing standards, potentially smoothing the path for Ethereum staking products. BlackRock’s Head of Digital Assets, Robert Mitchnick, called staking integration “the next phase” for ETH ETFs.

Major issuers including 21Shares, Fidelity, and Franklin Templeton have also filed to add staking to their ETH offerings. The U.S. recently saw the launch of its first staking-focused ETF, the REX-Osprey $ETH  + Staking ETF, though it currently holds only $2.4M.

Grayscale, meanwhile, staked 32,000 ETH on day one after enabling staking for its ETHE and ETH funds.

Despite recent outflows nearly $200M yesterday BlackRock’s ETHA remains the dominant ETH ETF. Staking’s ability to reduce circulating supply and generate yield makes it highly attractive, though it brings risks such as slashing and validator management that issuers must address carefully.

In Shenzhen, A U, who has been coding for six years, never expected to be entangled with Bitcoin. In 2018, when his daughter was born, he entered the market with his savings of 8000 U—not for getting rich, but to save some education fund for his child.

The cryptocurrency market has its own gentleness. After three bankruptcies in three years, when his account had less than 500 U left, the red light of the K-line hurt his eyes. His patience for debugging code was exhausted, his fingertips trembled, and his mind was filled with fluctuations, forgetting that his daughter had just called him "daddy" that morning.

After reflecting on his pain, he set a password for the trading software as "daughter’s birthday + rational initials," and instead used a hard-shell notebook to keep an "operation diary." The cover was decorated with his daughter’s stickers, and inside, rules like "crazy surges with unlimited volume are temptations" became his trading code, filled with restraint in every word.
Last year, when Bitcoin surged to 48,000, the office was filled with the excitement of colleagues increasing their positions. However, A Zhe frowned at the trading volume curve—volume shrank to one-third of the previous day, like a noisy office suddenly turning off the lights. He pulled out his notebook and decisively closed his positions. A week later, when the price dropped back to 39,000, while his friends slapped their thighs in regret, A Zhe was reading a picture book to his daughter, the sound of her laughter resonating in his ears, more pleasant than any K-line.

At the beginning of this year, when the price dropped to 29,000, it suddenly surged with high volume. A colleague next to him tugged at his arm shouting "buy the dip." A Zhe pressed down on the mouse, remembering "single volume spikes are not trustworthy," and stubbornly waited for five days. Only when the trading volume steadily increased did he enter the market with a small position. When his account soared from 8000 U to over 600,000, suddenly gaining 280,000, he didn’t smile but immediately uninstalled the trading software.

Now, that notebook filled with notes still sits on the desk, and the stickers from his daughter shine in the sunlight. A U often stares at it in a daze: "The K-line is the result, volume is the process." There are always people in the crypto world staring at the screen all night chasing news, but he has long detached his emotions from the numbers. The insomnia after bankruptcies and the reviews in the early hours are not for the numbers in the account but to stay true to oneself in the chaos—this is more precious than 280,000, more stable than all the ups and downs.

The neon lights outside have lit up again, resembling the endless fluctuations of the crypto market. A U closed the book and turned to heat milk for his daughter—some lights don’t need to be chased. #BTC #ETH

在深圳敲了六年代码的阿U，没料到会被比特币缠住。2018年女儿出生，他攥着8000U积蓄入市——不为暴富，只为给孩子存笔教育金。

币圈从不同情温柔。三年三次爆仓，账户只剩不到500U时，K线的红光刺得他眼疼。调试代码的耐心磨尽，指尖发颤，满脑子涨跌，竟忘了女儿今早刚喊他“爸爸”。

痛定思痛，他给交易软件设了“女儿生日+理性首字母”的密码，转而用硬壳本记“操作日记”。封皮贴着女儿的贴纸，里面“疯涨无量是诱多”等规律，成了他的交易法典，字里行间全是克制。

Emergency review of BTC death cross, is history repeating itself? After the last three new lows and death crosses, the average price broke through previous highs within 50 days!

Many people panic when they see a death cross in BTC's daily chart, fearing a significant drop. I carefully reviewed data from 2015 to the present, and this signal has appeared a total of 12 times. Interestingly, it can't be generalized; it depends on where it occurs. I divided them into two categories, and the results are starkly different.

First category: Most common, but the market tends to fall
This situation accounts for 9 occurrences. Its characteristic is that when the death cross happens, the price of Bitcoin is not at the lowest point of this decline. It might be during a rebound, or it has just started to fall after the rebound ended, but has not yet broken the previous low.

This "death cross not occurring at a new low position" tends to be more dangerous for future trends. Among these 9 times, there were 5 instances where the market continued to decline, and only 4 instances where it subsequently rose. So, to put it simply: if the death cross occurs without a new low, the probability of a subsequent drop is greater.

Second category: Rare cases, but bullish outlook
This situation has only occurred 3 times, but the pattern is very strong. Its feature is that when the death cross happens, the price is already in the low point area of this decline, or it has just set a new low. Moreover, within a few days after the death cross formation, the price will confirm this low point again.

The subsequent developments of these 3 historical cases are identical: all initiated an upward trend. On average, about 42 days later, the 50-day moving average will golden cross above the 200-day moving average; while the price will break through the high point before the death cross occurs in about 50 days.

My view on the current situation
The death cross that occurred on November 16, 2025, coincidentally aligns with the characteristics of the second category mentioned above; it occurred near a new low point of this decline.

From a historical perspective, it precisely indicates that the market may be building a bottom and initiating a significant rebound. title: Crypto has crashed this much – can Ethereum still fall further? And is there really any such thing a
subTitle:
In this article, two things will be clarified:
One – given the current situation, is Ethereum (ETH) still at risk of going lower?
Two – how and when do serious investors plan their entries so they don’t get trapped trying to catch one “perfect bottom”, yet still manage to buy at a good average price?
## Where does Ethereum stand right now?
Over the past few weeks, hundreds of billions of dollars in market cap have evaporated from the entire crypto market. Bitcoin, ETH and the major alts have all seen double-digit corrections.
Ethereum’s condition is roughly like this: from its all-time high it has already corrected quite a significant percentage. From a sentiment point of view, the market is clearly in “fear mode” – many are wondering, “Will it go even lower?”
# But at the same time, a few important things are also true. Activity on the L2 ecosystem (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Scroll, etc.) is still quite strong. The amount of ETH locked in staking is significant. DeFi, NFT, restaking, EigenLayer-type narratives are still primarily Ethereum-centric.
# In other words, even though the price chart looks bearish and emotional right now, on the fundamental and infra level Ethereum has not broken – this point is important.
## “Will it fall more?” – how to think about the downside scenarios
No one can say future price with 100% certainty. But combining data, technicals and history, it is possible to imagine some realistic scenarios.
# Many technical analysts are currently talking about roughly three major zones (the ranges are approximate, not exact numbers).
First, the short-term support zone. This is the support range just below the current price, where you typically see the first bounce or a few days of consolidation.
Second, the main “buy-the-dip” zone. Just below that sits a thicker demand band, where big bounces have happened before and where many mid and long-term investors place their orders. Many research sites treat this band as a “reasonable accumulation area”.
# Third, the deep panic or capitulation zone. This is a rare but possible layer further down, which usually doesn’t appear without a macro shock, a big liquidation wave or serious panic news. If price does come down here, long-term investors tend to buy very aggressively, but there is no guarantee that it will actually drop to this level.
# In short, purely from a technical perspective, ETH does have room to take another one or two steps lower. But exactly how far it will go, nobody knows. So “no further drop” and “a lot further down” – both have to be kept in mind as realistic scenarios.
## On the fundamental side – is the long-term thesis intact?
Beyond the technical chart, some big fundamental factors are still working in ETH’s favour.
After the Merge and EIP-1559, ETH issuance has dropped significantly. Annual effective inflation is now in a low single-digit range. A portion of the network fees is still being burned, so in the long term, pressure on supply is comparatively lower.
L2 scaling (rollups, blobs, etc.) is gradually transforming Ethereum mainnet into a settlement layer. Transactions are becoming much cheaper, and the network effect is growing further. DeFi TVL, NFT volume, stablecoin settlement – taken together, Ethereum is still being used as the default settlement and infra layer.
This is why most mid and long-term forecasts (from major research sites and investing firms) agree on one common point:
# Short-term heavy corrections are normal, but on a 1–3 year scale, there is no data that justifies calling ETH completely dead.
# So even though the price is currently in panic mode, on the infra and usage side Ethereum is not “structurally broken”.
## Why the idea of a “best time to buy” is a problem in itself
The most common trap is this:
“I will enter on that one perfect day, at a perfect price, which will be the absolute bottom – that’s when I’ll make the maximum profit.”
The problem is that this absolute bottom can only be recognised in hindsight. No one knows it in live markets. If someone waits only for the deep lower zone and, in the meantime, ETH reverses from the current level and moves straight towards a new high, then the entire up-move will be missed.
# On the other hand, if someone throws in all their money right now, and the price then drops another 30–40% below, the psychological pressure becomes so high that many people are unable to buy anything in the next strong zones.
# For this reason, serious investors do not try to catch a single perfect bottom. Instead, they work with probabilities and price bands. They accept: “I don’t know exactly where the bottom is, but I can identify a few good potential zones, and I will build my position slowly there.”
## What do serious investors actually do? Theory and practical strategy
First, band-based accumulation, or buying in slices according to price zones. The theory is very simple but powerful.
One: near the upper support, i.e. around the current zone, a portion of the total planned capital (say 25–30 percent) is deployed. Because if this zone later proves to be the bottom, at least some exposure is already in place.
Two: in the main dip zone, i.e. in the demand band one step further down, the larger part of the budget (say 40–50 percent) is reserved. This is usually where the best risk–reward appears, and where most technical and fundamental analysts mark a “strong demand zone”.
# Three: in the deep panic zone, i.e. in the rare but possible panic layer further below, the remaining small portion (say 20–30 percent) is kept. This zone is not always reached. But if price truly comes here, then a huge opportunity can appear, and long-term investors like to buy aggressively at this level.
# As a result, even without knowing exactly where the bottom is, one can gradually move down the average entry price across three layers. The idea is: buy a little higher up, buy more in the middle, and buy a bit extra if it goes all the way down. This is not pure prediction – it is planned reaction.
# Second, time-based DCA, or investing slowly over time. In this approach the decision is: “I won’t stare at price, I’ll buy a fixed amount at fixed intervals.”
# For example, suppose on a fixed date each month – say the 5th – the same amount of money is invested into Ethereum. When the market is high, fewer units are bought; when the market is low, more units are bought. This is called Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA).
# The philosophy is: instead of trying to catch the bottom, you spread your buying over time so that your average price settles somewhere in the middle. This reduces mental pressure, and you don’t have to keep your eyes glued to the chart 24/7.
# Third, a hybrid method. Many professional investors use both approaches together. A base DCA continues in the background (for example, once a month), and at the same time extra limit orders are placed in the lower strong zones.
# In this way, you get both types of benefits at once: time in the market and extra aggression at good price zones.
## In a fear phase – is it only fear, or also opportunity?
Right now, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index has been sitting in extreme fear for several days. History shows that extreme greed zones are often close to local tops or euphoria, while extreme fear zones often act as bottoms or at least as accumulation ranges.
But the important point here is that the Fear & Greed Index is never a perfect signal. It is essentially a thermometer, not a holy grail.
# Smart investors usually look at it like this: if the index is in extreme fear, the price is near a strong support, and the long-term thesis is still intact, then this creates an interesting context for gradually accumulating.
# On the other hand, if the macro backdrop becomes extremely bearish and something big and negative happens specifically to Ethereum (for example a critical bug or a very targeted regulatory attack), then jumping in just because the index shows fear can be dangerous. In that case, the entire thesis has to be re-examined.
## Realistic expectation – profit potential versus risk
Suppose someone spends 6–12 months mixing bands and DCA to stabilise their average entry price. Then they set a time horizon of 1–3 years. Many long-term models assume that in this cycle or the next, Ethereum can again break past its old high and move further up (for example to levels like 5–7 thousand dollars).
If the average entry is somewhere mid-range, and in the future the price really reaches those kinds of levels, then 2×, 3× or even higher risk-adjusted upside can be practically possible.
# But there is another side. If there is a macro crash or crypto enters another brutal bear cycle, any spot ETH buyer has to be mentally prepared to tolerate a 50–60 percent paper drawdown.
# In other words, a “medium risk, long-term ETH thesis” does not mean small, gentle waves. It means having the ability to endure big and prolonged drawdowns, and to maintain multi-year patience.

গত কয়েক সপ্তাহে পুরো ক্রিপ্টো মার্কেট থেকেই শত শত বিলিয়ন ডলার মার্কেট ক্যাপ উড়ে গেছে। Bitcoin, ETH, বড় alt সবাই ডাবল-ডিজিট correction দেখেছে।
Ethereum এর কন্ডিশন মোটামুটি এমন, অলটাইম হাই থেকে ইতিমধ্যেই যথেষ্ট পার্সেন্টেজ correction হয়েছে। sentiment দিক থেকে এখন স্পষ্টভাবে “fear মোড” চলছে, অনেকেই ভাবছে “আরও নিচে নামবে নাকি?”
কিন্তু একই সময়ে কিছু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ জিনিসও সত্যি, L2 ecosystem (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Scroll ইত্যাদি) এ activity এখনো যথেষ্ট শক্ত। staking এ locked ETH–এর পরিমাণ উল্লেখযোগ্য। DeFi, NFT, restaking, EigenLayer ধরনের narrative আজও মূলত Ethereum কেন্দ্রিক।
-
অর্থাৎ, price চার্ট এখন bearish আর emotional দেখালেও, fundamental ও infra লেভেলে Ethereum ভেঙে পড়েনি – এই পয়েন্টটা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
-
“আরও নামবে?” downside সিনারিওগুলো কীভাবে ভাবা যায়
-
ভবিষ্যতের price কেউই ১০০% নিশ্চিত করে বলতে পারে না। কিন্তু ডেটা, টেকনিক্যাল এবং history মিলিয়ে কিছু realistic সিনারিও কল্পনা করা যায়
অনেক টেকনিক্যাল অ্যানালিস্ট এখন মোটামুটি তিনটা বড় zone নিয়ে কথা বলছে (রেঞ্জগুলো আনুমানিক, exact সংখ্যা নয়)।
-
প্রথমত, শর্ট-টার্ম সাপোর্ট জোন। এটা বর্তমান প্রাইসের ঠিক নিচে থাকা support রেঞ্জ, যেখানে সাধারণত প্রথম বাউন্স বা কিছুদিনের consolidation দেখা যায়।
দ্বিতীয়ত, মূল “buy-the-dip” zone। এর একটু নিচে থাকে মোটা একটি demand band, যেখানে আগেও বড় bounce হয়েছে এবং অনেক mid ও long-term ইনভেস্টররা order বসিয়ে রাখে। অনেক রিসার্চ সাইট এই band কেই “reasonable accumulation area” হিসেবে ধরে।
তৃতীয়ত, deep panic বা capitulation zone। এটা নিচের দিকে rare কিন্তু possible একটা লেয়ার, যেটা সাধারণত macro শক, বড় liquidation wave বা panic news ছাড়া খুব একটা ধরা পড়ে না। এখানে এসে পড়লে long-term ইনভেস্টররা খুব আক্রমণাত্মকভাবে buy করতে চায়, কিন্তু আদৌ সেই লেভেলে নামবে কিনা সেটার কোনো গ্যারান্টি নেই।
-
সংক্ষেপে, purely টেকনিক্যাল দিক থেকে দেখলে ETH র আরও এক-দুই ধাপ নিচে নামার জায়গা আছে। কিন্তু ঠিক কত পর্যন্ত নামবে, সেটা কেউ জানে না। তাই কিছুই না নামা আর অনেক নিচে নামা, দুইটাই বাস্তবসম্মত সিনারিও হিসেবে মাথায় রাখতে হয়।
-
ফান্ডামেন্টাল সাইড, long-term থিসিস কি ঠিক আছে?
-
টেকনিক্যাল চার্টের বাইরেও ETH–র কিছু বড় ফান্ডামেন্টাল ফ্যাক্টর এখনো কাজ করছে
Merge এবং EIP-1559 এর পর ETH ইস্যুয়েন্স উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে কমেছে। বার্ষিক ইফেক্টিভ inflation এখন low single-digit রেঞ্জে চলে এসেছে। নেটওয়ার্ক ফি এর একটা অংশ এখনো বার্ন হয়, ফলে long-term এ supply এর উপর চাপ তুলনামূলকভাবে কম।
L2 scaling (rollup, blobs ইত্যাদি) Ethereum mainnet কে ধীরে ধীরে settlement layer এ রূপান্তর করছে। লেনদেন অনেক সস্তা হচ্ছে, আর network effect আরও বাড়ছে। DeFi TVL, NFT volume, stablecoin settlement সব মিলিয়ে Ethereum এখনো ডিফল্ট settlement এবং infra layer হিসেবেই ব্যবহার হচ্ছে।
এই কারণেই বেশিরভাগ mid ও long-term ফোরকাস্ট (বড় রিসার্চ সাইট ও ইনভেস্টিং ফার্মগুলো) এক কমন পয়েন্টে একমত হয়।
শর্ট-টার্মে কঠিন correction হওয়া স্বাভাবিক, কিন্তু ১-৩ বছরের স্কেলে ETH কে পুরোপুরি dead ধরে নেওয়ার মতো কোনো ডেটা নেই।
-
অর্থাৎ, price এখন panic mood এ থাকলেও infra এবং usage দিক থেকে Ethereum “structurally broken” নয়।
-
“Best time to buy” ধারণাটা কেন নিজেই সমস্যাযুক্ত
-
সবচেয়ে সাধারণ trap হলো  “আমি এমন এক দিনে, একটা দামে ঢুকবো, যেটা হবে absolute bottom, তখনই সবচেয়ে বেশি লাভ।”
সমস্যা হচ্ছে, এই absolute bottom কেবল history দেখে বোঝা যায়, লাইভ মার্কেটে কেউ জানে না। যদি কেউ শুধু deep lower zone এর জন্য অপেক্ষা করতে করতে current level থেকে ETH উল্টে সরাসরি আবার নতুন high এর দিকে চলে যায়, তাহলে পুরো up-move মিস হয়ে যাবে।
আবার যদি কেউ সব টাকা একবারে এখন লাগিয়ে দেয়, আর price যদি এখান থেকে আরেক ৩০–৪০% নীচে নেমে যায়, তখন মানসিক চাপ এত বেড়ে যায় যে অনেকেই পরের strong zone এ আর কিছু কিনতেই পারে না।
-
সিরিয়াস ইনভেস্টররা তাই একটিমাত্র perfect bottom ধরার চেষ্টা না করে probabilities আর price band নিয়ে কাজ করে। তারা ধরে নেয়, “bottom ঠিক কোথায় তা জানি না, কিন্তু সম্ভাব্য কয়েকটা ভাল জোন ধরতে পারি, আর সেখানে ধীরে ধীরে build করব।
-
সিরিয়াস ইনভেস্টররা কী করে? থিওরি আর প্র্যাকটিক্যাল স্ট্র্যাটেজি
-
প্রথমত, band-based accumulation বা price zone ধরে ভাগ করে কেনা। এই থিওরি খুব simple, কিন্তু শক্তিশালী।
এক, উপরের সাপোর্টের কাছে, অর্থাৎ current zone এর আশেপাশে, total প্ল্যান করা ক্যাপিটালের একটা অংশ (ধরা যাক ২৫–৩০ শতাংশ) deploy করা হয়। কারণ, যদি এই জায়গাটাই পরে bottom প্রমাণিত হয়, তাহলে অন্তত কিছু exposure পাওয়া হয়ে যায়।
দুই, মূল dip zone এ, অর্থাৎ আরও এক ধাপ নিচের demand band এ, বাজেটের বড় অংশ (ধরা যাক ৪০–৫০ শতাংশ) reserve থাকে। এই zone এ সাধারণত সবচেয়ে ভালো risk–reward দেখা যায়, যেখানে বেশিরভাগ টেকনিক্যাল ও ফান্ডামেন্টাল বিশ্লেষক “strong demand zone” হিসেবে চিহ্নিত করে।
তিন, deep panic zone এ, অর্থাৎ খুব rare কিন্তু possible panic লেয়ারে, বাকি ছোট অংশ (ধরা যাক ২০–৩০ শতাংশ) রাখা হয়। এই zone এ নামার ঘটনা অনেক সময় ঘটে না। কিন্তু যদি সত্যিই এখানে এসে পড়ে, then huge opportunity তৈরি হয় বলে long-term ইনভেস্টররা এই লেভেলে আগ্রাসীভাবে কিনতে চায়।
-
ফলে bottom ঠিক কোথায় সেটা না জানলেও, তিনটি লেয়ারে গড় দামে ধীরে ধীরে নামা যায়। ধরেই নেওয়া হয়, উপরে কিছু, মাঝখানে বেশি, এবং একদম নিচে গেলে আরেকটু বেশি কেনা হবে। এটা pure prediction নয়, বরং planned reaction।
-
দ্বিতীয়ত, time-based DCA বা সময় ধরে ধীরে ধীরে ইনভেস্ট করা। এ ক্ষেত্রে সিদ্ধান্ত হয়, “price দেখে কিছু না, fixed interval এ fixed amount কিনব।”
-
উদাহরণ হিসেবে ধরা যাক, প্রতি মাসে একটা fixed date, যেমন মাসের ৫ তারিখে, একই পরিমাণ টাকা Ethereum এ ইনভেস্ট করা হচ্ছে। মার্কেট উপরে থাকলে কম ইউনিট, নিচে থাকলে বেশি ইউনিট কেনা হয়। এটাকেই Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA) বলা হয়।
-
এর দর্শন হচ্ছে, bottom ধরার চেষ্টা না করে সময়ের উপর ছড়িয়ে কেনার মাধ্যমে average price কে মাঝামাঝি এক জায়গায় নিয়ে আসা। এতে mental চাপ কমে, আর চার্টে ২৪ ঘণ্টা চোখ গেঁথে রাখতে হয় না।
-
তৃতীয়ত, hybrid পদ্ধতি অনেক প্রফেশনাল ইনভেস্টর দুটি পদ্ধতিই একসাথে ব্যবহার করে। একটি base DCA চলতেই থাকে (ধরা যাক প্রতি মাসে একবার), আর একই সঙ্গে নিচের strong zone গুলোতে extra limit order বসিয়ে রাখা থাকে।
-
এর ফলে time in the market এবং good price zone এ extra aggression দুই ধরনের সুবিধাই একসাথে পাওয়া যায়।
-
Fear phase এ শুধু ভয়, নাকি সুযোগও?
-
এখন Crypto Fear & Greed Index বেশ কিছুদিন ধরে extreme fear এ অবস্থান করছে। ইতিহাস দেখায়, extreme greed zone অনেক সময় local top বা euphoria র কাছাকাছি থাকে, আর extreme fear zone প্রায়ই bottom বা অন্তত একটি accumulation range হিসেবে কাজ করে।
কিন্তু এখানে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কথা হলো, Fear & Greed Index কখনোই perfect সিগন্যাল নয়। এটা মূলত একটি থার্মোমিটার, কোনো holy grail নয়।
স্মার্ট ইনভেস্টররা সাধারণত এভাবে দেখে, যদি ইন্ডেক্স extreme fear এ থাকে, তার সঙ্গে যদি price কোনো strong সাপোর্টের কাছ থাকে, আর long-term thesis ঠিকঠাক থাকে, তখন ধীরে ধীরে accumulate করার জন্য এটি একটা interesting context তৈরি করে।
-
অন্যদিকে, যদি macro ভীষণ bearish হয়ে যায়, Ethereum সংক্রান্ত বড় কোনো negative fundamental আসে (যেমন critical bug, খুব targeted regulatory আঘাত), তখন শুধু fear দেখে ঝাঁপিয়ে পড়া dangerous হতে পারে। এ সময়ে পুরো থিসিসটাকে আবার নতুন করে যাচাই করতে হয়।
-
Realistic expectation - লাভের সম্ভাবনা বনাম ঝুঁকি
-
ধরা যাক কেউ ৬–১২ মাস ধরে band এবং DCA মিশিয়ে নিজের গড় entry price কে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ করার চেষ্টা করল। তারপর horizon ধরল ১–৩ বছর। অনেক দীর্ঘমেয়াদি মডেল যেখানে ধরে নিচ্ছে, এই সাইকেলে বা পরের সাইকেলে Ethereum আবার পুরনো হাই ভেঙে আরও উপরে যেতে পারে (ধরো ৫–৭ হাজার ডলারের মতো লেভেলে), সেখানে গড় entry যদি মাঝামাঝি রেঞ্জে হয়, আর future এ মূল্য সত্যিই ওই ধরনের লেভেলে পৌঁছায়, তাহলে ২ গুণ, ৩ গুণ বা তারও বেশি risk-adjusted upside practical হতে পারে।
কিন্তু অন্য দিকও আছে। macro crash হলে বা ক্রিপ্টো আরেকটি brutal bear cycle এ ঢুকে গেলে, যে কোনো spot ETH buyer কেই ৫০–৬০ শতাংশ পর্যন্ত paper drawdown মানসিকভাবে tolerate করার জন্য তৈরি থাকতে হবে।
-
এর মানে, “medium risk, long-term ETH thesis” মানে ছোটখাটো ঢেউ নয়। এর মানে হচ্ছে বড় ও দীর্ঘ drawdown সহ্য করার ক্ষমতা এবং multi-year patience।

Many people saw the BTC daily-chart death cross on November 16, 2025 and instantly panicked. But if you’ve watched enough market cycles, you already know one thing: signals don’t always mean what textbooks say. Sometimes the most frightening indicators end up becoming the biggest opportunities.
A death cross traditionally occurs when the 50-day MA crosses below the 200-day MA—usually interpreted as a bearish continuation signal. However, when I dug through BTC’s historical data from 2015 to now, a very different pattern showed up. Out of 12 total death crosses, 9 were the “normal” type where the price wasn’t at a new low. Those mostly did lead to more downside. But the other 3? They were extremely different—they appeared after BTC had already hit a new low. These three cases behaved nothing like typical death crosses. In all of them, Bitcoin formed one last small dip within the next 1–2 candles, then launched into a powerful rebound.
More interestingly, in every single one of those “Golden Version” cases, BTC went on to: • regain a golden cross in about 42 days
• break previous highs within roughly 50 days
Now look at today’s chart. The November 16, 2025 death cross appears at a confirmed new low, aligning perfectly with those rare, bullish historical patterns. It doesn’t guarantee a repeat, but markets often rhyme. When sentiment is at its darkest, that’s when big reversals tend to begin.
Do you think we’re about to see another one of those explosive rebounds?

title: ETH巨鲸鱼增持，和普通人有什么关系？
subTitle:
#ETH巨鲸增持 ETH 巨鲸又增持了，这说明了什么？
#加密市场回调 最近链上数据又显示：有几位大户（俗称巨鲸）开始明显增持 ETH。很多朋友一听“巨鲸动作”，就觉得是不是要起飞了？其实我们用更接地气的方式来说说这件事到底意味着什么。
#ETH 
巨鲸为什么增持？
巨鲸的钱不是大风刮来的，他们买东西一般有理由：
1）看重长期价值
ETH 现在不仅仅是“一个币”，它是整个以太坊生态的门票。Defi、NFT、Layer2 都要靠它。巨鲸增持，多半是看好未来几年 ETH 的地位不会被撼动。
2）行情冷的时候好捡便宜
巨鲸最喜欢干的事，就是别人恐慌、价格回调的时候慢慢吸货。越安静，他们越容易买到舒服的位置。
3）ETH 减产 + 销毁机制作用更明显
以太坊现在是 通缩模型（销毁的比新发的多的时候就是通缩）。长期看，供应越少越值钱。这类结构性的东西巨鲸比普通人更敏感。
巨鲸增持＝马上涨？
不等于！但属于中长期的强信号。
巨鲸买入只能说明：
他们觉得这个价格 值得布局风险回报比 合适长期更看好上涨的概率
短期涨不涨，要看市场情绪、宏观、比特币走势等各种因素。
一句话：巨鲸买是“方向”，不是“立刻涨”的按钮。
3. 普通人该怎么办？
不是让你跟着 all in，而是可以参考巨鲸的思路来做判断：
用“小仓位、长期定投”的方式布局
巨鲸是“分批买”，普通人也一样，小额慢慢买会比追涨杀跌安全得多。
看方向，不看情绪
巨鲸从不靠情绪交易，他们都是看趋势、看结构、看长期。

别被短期波动吓走
巨鲸增持说明他们更关注 半年 - 几年 的行情，而不是今天涨不涨。
巨鲸的行为永远不是“巧合”
他们增持，代表 聪明钱在回流 ETH。
不需要跟巨鲸一样有钱，但可以学一点他们的节奏：看大方向，稳稳拿，不被短期吓跑。

title: ETH не спешит отрываться от $3000, кто же сдерживает рост его цены?
subTitle:
Уровень в $3000 для $ETH  превратился в полноценный магнит: цена то уходит чуть ниже, то возвращается обратно, но устойчивого рывка вверх рынок пока не показывает. Технически эта зона одновременно и поддержка, и барьер: при падении сюда актив начинают выкупать, при подходе снизу трейдеры фиксируют прибыль и открывают короткие позиции. В классическом теханализе такое поведение описывается как борьба вокруг важного уровня поддержки и сопротивления, который многократно тестируется рынком и от которого запускаются обе стороны ордера. 

{future}(ETHUSDT)

Если искать тех, кто сдерживает рост, в первую очередь стоит смотреть на сторону предложения. На отрезке последних недель ETH регулярно сталкивается с продажами при попытках уходить выше диапазона $3000–$3500: индикаторы показывают слабый импульс, цена застревает под важными скользящими средними, а часть участников использует любые отскоки, чтобы разгрузить позиции. Дополнительное давление создают оттоки из спотовых продуктов на базе ETH и общая осторожность инвесторов на фоне колебаний ожиданий по ставкам и рисковых активов в целом. На таком фоне уровень в $3000 превращается в удобную точку для продавцов, а не в стартовый трамплин. 

При этом картину нельзя назвать односторонней: на тех же уровнях активно работают крупные покупатели. Свежие данные показывают, что именно в зоне около $3000 за последние дни прошли масштабные накопления со стороны крупных адресов на сумму свыше миллиарда долларов, что помогло удержать цену выше психологического барьера даже на фоне слабой техники и нервного настроения. Рынок балансирует между медвежьими сигналами индикаторов и заметным спросом от тех, кто воспринимает текущие значения как разумную долгосрочную точку входа, а не начало обвала. 

В итоге вопрос “кто сдерживает рост ETH” на самом деле о другом. На уровне в $3000 столкнулись сразу несколько сил: фиксация прибыли и продажи со стороны осторожного капитала, техническое сопротивление, слабый импульс вверх — против крупного спроса от игроков, готовых покупать просадку. До тех пор, пока одна из сторон явно не возьмет верх, ETH и дальше будет “вязнуть” вокруг этой отметки, а не улетать в одну из сторон. Для нас, как участников рынка, важнее не искать конкретного “виновника”, а следить за тем, как меняются объемы, поведение крупных адресов и реакция цены на очередные тесты $3000: именно в этих деталях и прячется ответ, где и когда ETH наконец перестанет ходить вокруг этого уровня кругами.

The U.S. non-farm data for September is about to be revealed! How can cryptocurrency players take advantage of this opportunity? A deep analysis by Zitan!

Hello everyone, I am Zitan. Today we won't talk about altcoins or technical analysis, but focus on one big event: the upcoming release of the U.S. September non-farm employment data! What does this data have to do with our crypto space? A lot!

The U.S. September unemployment rate is expected to be 4.3%, the same as last month; the non-farm employment population is expected to be only 50,000, which is higher than the previous value of 22,000 but still relatively low; the initial jobless claims are expected to be 230,000, and the year-on-year wage growth is expected to be 3.7%. These figures may seem dull, but they are actually indicators of the Federal Reserve's policy direction!

Why should crypto enthusiasts pay attention to these? Let me give you a recent example: on the day the August non-farm data fell short of expectations, Bitcoin surged nearly 3% within half an hour, and Ethereum followed suit. Why? Because the economic data was poor, the market expected the Federal Reserve might slow down interest rate hikes or even cut rates, improving liquidity expectations, leading funds to rush into high-risk assets like cryptocurrencies!

So how should we respond when this data is released?
Zitan's view is very clear: do not gamble on the data, but rather prepare in advance! If the data is below expectations, it will be a short-term positive for the crypto market, and you might consider taking profits in batches; if the data is above expectations, the market may be volatile, but a dip could present an opportunity, especially since Bitcoin has strong support around $60,000.

If wages rise quickly, it indicates persistent inflation pressure, and the Federal Reserve may continue to be tough. This puts pressure on both the stock market and the crypto space. But if wage growth is moderate, even if the non-farm data looks good, the market might interpret it as "the economy is not hot, and the probability of interest rate hikes is low."

🚀 $XRP  Leads the Pack — Retail Up 60% While BTC & ETH Lag Behind

Despite the market collapse, on-chain data showed XRP retail investors up 60%. The Bitcoin and Ethereum figures are compared here.

Retail Realized XRP Price Puts Profit Margin Around 60%
In a recent article on X, on-chain analytics startup Glassnode examines retail profitability of $BTC , Ethereum, and XRP. Retail investors are the smallest market players with balances under $1,000. Glassnode calculated this cohort's profit-loss balance using the Realized Price indicator.

Realized Price represents a network segment's average cost basis or acquisition level. If the asset's current price is above this threshold, the group has net unrealized gain. However, falling beneath the measure indicates cohort loss domination.

As seen in the graph, XRP has been falling, although its price still lags behind retail companies' Realized Prices. Current average profit for this category is 60%. Ethereum retail holders are also profitable, but just 40%.

XRP and $ETH  are inferior than Bitcoin. Even after the price drop, BTC retail addresses average over 100% profit.

How are regular investors using their profits? On-chain analytics company Santiment clarified in an X post. Selling has happened on all three networks lately, as seen in the cohort holdings chart below.

Bitcoin retail was accumulating until the latest price plunge, but this bearish wave has spooked them into selling 0.36% of their supply over the last five days, which is the highest rate of distribution in two months. Ethereum retail has been fleeing for a while, and its holdings have dropped 0.90% in the previous month.

Vitalik Buterin is against institutional takeover of Ethereum.

Buterin believes that if BlackRock and other large investors continue to actively accumulate ETH, this could lead to two key threats to the network:

I have always firmly believed — analysis leads to victory.

Liu Sheng has never been someone who relies on luck to make a living. Behind that myth of a thousand times return is not a sudden flash of inspiration, but countless nights spent staring at K-lines, observing structures, rhythms, and emotional shifts. While others sleep, I review; while others chase profits and cut losses, I calculate the game space.

However, the extreme market conditions of the past month have nearly chewed me up.

Especially Ethereum. No matter how beautifully the positions are set, there will always be a spike that pierces through the structure. You clearly grasp the direction, yet get shaken out before the direction takes off. You accurately calculate the rhythm, yet get countered by the market before the rhythm arrives.

To put it bluntly, this feeling is really frustrating.

When a game lacks technical support, all that's left is gambling. Yet the current market has never turned into a pure gambling situation. Behind every counter-sweep of orders, behind every yin and yang spike, there are people calculating, targeting, and competing. This is not mindless mutual destruction between robots, but a game with intentions, strategies, and opponents.

As long as there are “people” in this market, there will always be competition. Since there is competition, one must rely on analysis to win.

My deepest realization during this time is: the market will not reward you forever, but it won’t punish you forever either. When the market is extreme, rhythms become chaotic, spikes increase, and directions seem false, but the underlying logic of “analysis” remains unchanged: structure, rhythm, emotion, and space are the roots of all trends.

A thousand times return is not achieved by guesswork, but is walked out through analysis.

I will not be discouraged now, nor will I be blind. These positions that have been countered, these orders that have been swept away, these shattered structures will ultimately become the chips for my next success.

The only thing I need to do next is one thing — regain everything that has been taken from me through analysis.

The market will not always stand by my side, but I will not always remain in the valley. As long as I am still analyzing, I will always be fighting. And as long as I am fighting, I will definitely win.

我始终坚信——分析致胜。

琉生从来不是靠运气吃饭的人。那段千倍神话的背后，不是灵光乍现，而是无数个夜里盯着 K 线看结构、看节奏、看情绪的偏移。别人睡觉，我在复盘；别人追涨杀跌，我在计算博弈空间。

但近一个来的极端行情，却几乎把我啃了一遍。

尤其是以太。点位布局得再漂亮，总会来那么一根扎破结构的针。你明明抓到了方向，却在方向启动前被抖出去。你明明算准了节奏，却在节奏到来前被市场反杀。

这种感觉说难听点，真的老火。

有人说我是不是不行了，方法是不是失效了，是不是该靠赌一把来翻本，但我比谁都清楚：真正能让我站起来的，从来不是运气，而是分析。

当一个博弈盘没有技术面支撑，那剩下的只有赌博。可眼下的盘，从没变成过纯赌局。每一次反向扫单、每一根阴阳针刺进去的背后，都有人在算、在狙、在博弈。这不是机器人之间的无脑互砸，而是有意图、有思路、有对手存在的盘。

只要这个市场里还有“人”，那就一定还有博弈。既然有博弈，就一定要靠分析去胜出。

我这段时间最深的感悟就是：市场不会永远奖励你，但也不会永远惩罚你。行情极端的时候，节奏会乱、针会多、方向会假，但“分析”的底层逻辑不会变：结构、节奏、情绪、空间，是所有走势的根。

千倍收益不是靠蒙的，是靠分析走出来的。

现在的我不会气馁，也不会盲目。这些被反咬的点位、这些被针扫掉的单子、这些碎裂的结构，最终都会成为我下一次成功的筹码。

下一步我要做的只有一件事——凭借分析，夺回被夺走的一切。

行情不会永远站在我这边，但我也不会永远站在低谷。只要我还在分析，那我就永远在战斗。而只要在战斗，我就一定会赢。

title: First U.S. Spot XRP ETF Could Go Live This Thursday: A Milestone for Digital Assets
subTitle:
The U.S. crypto market is on the verge of witnessing a historic milestone as the first-ever U.S. Spot XRP ETF, managed by Canary Funds, is expected to go live this Thursday. This move represents a major step forward for the digital asset industry, particularly in providing U.S. investors with direct and fully-backed exposure to XRP for the first time.
What’s Happening
Canary Funds recently completed the Form 8-A filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), signaling that the ETF has met all registration requirements and is ready for listing. Analysts, including Bloomberg’s Eric Balchunas, suggest that approval often follows quickly, with the fund potentially launching within 24 hours of filing. The ETF will become effective once Nasdaq certifies the listing, which is expected by Wednesday evening, putting a Thursday debut well within reach.
Why This Matters
This launch could fundamentally reshape institutional access to XRP, moving beyond the traditional Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF landscape. Unlike futures-based or blended-asset ETFs, Canary’s offering is 100% spot-backed, meaning it holds actual XRP in custody. This provides cleaner exposure, better tracking, and more efficient tax treatment — features that make it particularly attractive for institutional investors, registered investment advisers (RIAs), and professional traders.
The ETF’s debut could also enhance market liquidity, improve price discovery, and increase investor confidence in XRP. With direct spot exposure, participants no longer need to navigate complex on-chain custody or rely on derivative products, making this a fully regulated, transparent investment vehicle.
Comparison With Existing Products
Currently, other XRP-related ETFs like the XRPR ETF hold a mix of assets and provide only partial XRP exposure. This can result in:
Higher tracking variance
Limited institutional appeal
Less efficient tax treatment
Canary’s ETF, by contrast, is entirely backed by XRP, offering a transparent and straightforward structure that directly mirrors the market price of the token. This distinction is expected to draw both retail and institutional inflows.
Market Implications
XRP has been trading near $2.48 in early Wednesday Asian markets, down roughly 5% amid a broader crypto market pullback. Analysts suggest that a confirmed launch could catalyze renewed trading activity, potentially stabilizing the price.
Beyond immediate market impact, the approval of a pure spot XRP ETF could signal growing regulatory openness toward alternative crypto assets. Applications for spot ETFs on other networks, such as Solana, are already under review. Success here could pave the way for more diversified, regulated blockchain-based investment products in the U.S., expanding the crypto ETF ecosystem beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum.
Key Takeaways
The first U.S. Spot XRP ETF could go live this Thursday, pending Nasdaq certification.
It will be 100% XRP-backed, offering cleaner and more transparent exposure than blended ETFs.
The launch could broaden institutional access, boost liquidity, and improve price discovery.
Analysts and market participants are watching closely, as this could signal a new phase in U.S. crypto ETF adoption.
With the ETF set to debut, the crypto world is watching eagerly, as XRP may finally gain a regulated, transparent investment channel in the U.S., potentially changing the dynamics of both retail and institutional trading.

Decline Exploration: Multiple Factors Create a 'Perfect Storm'
Federal Reserve Policy Shift
The Federal Reserve's hawkish stance is the core trigger for this round of sharp declines. The market previously widely expected that a rate cut cycle would begin in the fourth quarter of 2025, but the persistently high core PCE inflation rate exceeding 2% shattered this illusion.
In the November Federal Reserve meeting, Powell clearly stated that 'interest rates will remain high for a longer period.'
The CME 'FedWatch' tool shows that traders currently believe the probability of a rate cut in December is only about 30%, while a month ago this probability was as high as 94%.
【Institutional Funds Withdrawal】
Institutional funds that once supported the market's rise are now withdrawing on a large scale. The U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF has seen net outflows for five consecutive weeks, totaling $2.6 billion.
BlackRock's IBIT ETF experienced an outflow of $420 million in a single week, setting a record for the largest weekly outflow since the fund's inception.
Market sentiment indicators have deteriorated sharply. The Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 16, entering the 'extreme fear' zone.
Monitoring of social media platforms shows that keyword searches such as 'Bitcoin crash' and 'bear market is here' have surged fivefold, with related topics on Twitter exceeding 2 billion views.
Market attention is now focused on the Federal Reserve meeting on December 10. The current market pricing estimates the probability of a 25 basis point rate cut by the Federal Reserve in December at 44.4%.
Historical data shows that since 2020, after the Federal Reserve signals a rate cut, Bitcoin often sees a rebound of 15%-20% within 1-3 months.
Bitcoin, like other risk assets, is under pressure, but due to unique factors in cryptocurrency, its downward pressure is amplified. When this cryptocurrency winter will end largely depends on the Federal Reserve's next actions. #BTC #ETH

Learning and Sharing👊

You are purchasing $BTC  and $ETH  via DCA. Great! But, where is your money? The key to crypto security is understanding custody.

The Main Rule: If you don't own the keys, you don't own the coins.

1. 🏦 Option 1: Exchange (Ex: Binance)
   Advantage: Easy to use, ideal for beginners and quick trades. This is where you do the DCA.
   Disadvantage: The private key (the master password for your funds) is controlled by Binance. You trust the company to protect your funds.

2. 🔑 Option 2: Personal Wallet (Hardware or Software)
   Advantage: 
Maximum Security! You control 100% of your private key (Seed Phrase). If the exchange closes, your funds are safe.
   Disadvantage:
 The responsibility is 100% yours. If you lose the key, there is no way to recover your funds.

🔥 Transition Strategy for the Beginner:
Keep in the exchange the amount you are using for trading or DCA in the short term. Transfer the rest (the long-term amount) to a "Personal Wallet" after learning what a Seed Phrase is and how to keep it in a safe place, offline.
